title: Phase-gated launch corridor and regional ramp playbook for runtime/console/api
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Create an operational playbook and calendar pattern that coordinates a phase-gated launch corridor across the Runtime, Console, and API surfaces. The purpose is to (1) reduce cross-team ambiguity during canary/capacity ramp, (2) define regional ramp order (NA -> EU -> APAC) with explicit SLA smoke windows, and (3) give step-by-step gating criteria tied to telemetry, cost, and security checks. This ticket captures the decision record, runbook steps, stakeholder owners, and the calendar template to be reused for future model/runtime releases.
acceptance_criteria: Shared calendar template uploaded to Drive and referenced by all three teams
Phase gate checklist defined with measurable thresholds for latency, error rate, and cost delta
Canary lanes and sizes (alpha, beta, GA) documented with rollback thresholds
Regional ramp order and blackout windows defined and approved by infra/regional ops
Operational runbook validated in a smoke drill with on-call rotation and post-mortem template
comments: 2025-02-18 — Liam O'Connor: Initial ticket created after cross-team sync. Scope: runtime + console + api coordination for model serving launches. Action: PMs to nominate owners for each lane.
2025-02-20 — Priya Natarajan: Proposed three-phase lanes (alpha-internal, beta-external, GA) and suggested NA->EU->APAC ramp. Posted draft calendar to Drive and requested engineering SLO thresholds.

2025-02-24 — Diego Alvarez (Eng Lead - Runtime): Runtime prefers rolling canaries with KV-cache priming rather than blue-green due to in-memory state; added requirement for cache-warmup validation tool (ENG-4988).

2025-02-26 — Maya Chen (Console PM): Console will gate on per-route latency P95 <= 120ms and telemetry ingestion completeness > 98% before expanding canary size. Raised question about telemetry retention for post-rollout analysis.

2025-02-28 — Security review note: Security team flagged VPC-related docs for Private deployments; asked for explicit checklist item. Decided to include a 'data path validation' gate for Private customers (added to checklist).

2025-03-01 — Ops (Regional): Agreed on NA weekend window for initial beta ramp to minimize customer overlap in APAC. Ops requested pre-ramp runbook walkthrough and a smoke drill date (target 2025-03-18).

2025-03-02 — Priya Natarajan: Incorporated feedback; updated checklist thresholds and added rollback play. Created draft runbook for smoke drill and assigned owners. Linking to the draft runbook in Confluence.

2025-03-03 — Review feedback from Eng PMs: Need to add explicit cost guardrail (per-token cost increase <= 8%) and observe model-quality regression metrics (top-3 prompt set) during canary. Assigned follow-up tasks to ENG-4827 and ENG-4988.
steps: Draft calendar template and publish to Drive
Define phase gate checklist (metrics + manual checks)
Align canary sizes and rollback thresholds across runtime/console/api
Schedule smoke drill with on-call and runbook owners
Execute smoke drill and capture learnings
Finalize playbook and distribute to GTM and Support
Operationalize template for next release and add to release-train checklist
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Cross-team mismatch on gating thresholds could cause premature expansion -> Mitigation: tie gates to specific dashboards and require sign-off from each surface owner
Risk: Regional capacity constraints during ramp -> Mitigation: Pre-reserve burst capacity with Dedicated team and document fallback model variants
Risk: Hidden model-quality regressions -> Mitigation: Run automated evals on canary traffic and block on regression alerts
